title: African Wild Dogs Catch Their Prey About 80 Percent of the Time

scenes.text: The most successful hunter in Africa isn't a lion.
African wild dogs catch their prey about eighty percent of the time.
Lions manage roughly a quarter of their hunts.
The dogs hunt in packs of five to twenty, sneaking close before the chase.
They can hit forty-one miles an hour for about three miles.
The smallest hunter beats the king. Watch it again.

description:
The most successful hunter in Africa isn't a lion.
African wild dogs catch their prey about eighty percent of the time, while lions manage about a quarter. Teamwork is their secret.
Would you bet on the pack or the lion?
first_comment: Bonus: wild dogs can lose about half their kills to other predators. Is that fair?
